title: A folder that syncs everywhere
text: A folder on my computer that automatically syncs my files to every device I own and to the web, so I stop emailing files to myself and carrying a USB stick around.
outcome: Dropbox launched in 2008 and became a public company. Today the problem is solved by storage bundled with every phone and computer, so the honest verdict for a new entrant is 'Already solved'.

competitors.name: Google Drive
competitors.priceNote: Google One 100 GB to 2 TB, monthly

competitors.name: OneDrive
competitors.priceNote: 100 GB plan to Microsoft 365 Personal, monthly

key.riskiestAssumption: People will pay for another sync service when Google Drive, iCloud and OneDrive already come with their phone or computer, free up to a limit.
key.notes: A desk check should land on 'Already solved' or a narrow wedge. Naming Dropbox itself counts as a competitor match.
